title: Manufacture: 3D Contour round a plain 60 x 40 x 12 block with only 2 mm of stock at its sides (it made no toolpath before 0.1.0-beta.4.0.3), with a flat and a ball 6 mm tool

steps.comment: the setup's origin at the stock's top centre: the block from X -30 to 30, Y -20 to 20, Z -13 to -1; 2 mm of stock at the sides, less than the 6 mm tool's radius plus room for FreeCAD's scan (manufacture_core.waterline_margin)

the tool's centre goes round the walls 3 mm (its radius) out, plus up to one grid step (manufacture_core.waterline_sample: 6 / 24 = 0.25 mm), never in; five passes stepping down half the tool's diameter (Z -3, -6, -9, -12 and the bottom, -13): a lap of about 2 x (66.5 + 46.5) = 226 mm plus the corners, x 5 = 1173 mm. Before the fix: no toolpath at all, and with a wider stock one pass at the bottom only
the same walls with a ball end: its centre stays 3 mm from the block (checked move by move: nearest 3.0009 mm)

expect.note: The design is not changed by the setup or its operations: 60 x 40 x 12 = 28,800 mm3. The toolpaths' numbers are in the cam_expect steps, in the setup's own coordinates.
